THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, AUGUST 13, 1937

Kita To Be Replaced
By Kumakichi Harada

Military Attache To Be Re-
called To Japan

Major-Gen. Seiichi Kita, military
attache to the Japanese Embassy
in China for the past 17 months,
will leave here for Japan on August
15 aboard the m.v. Tatsuta Maru,
the military attache office an-
nounced yesterday.
Following his arrival in the
Capital, the announcement added,
the officer will be promoted.
The Shanghai Nichi-Nichi said
Major-Gen. Kumakichi Harada,
Commander of the Fourth Regi-
ment of the Imperial Guards
Division, will succeed Major-Gen.
Kita, who will be attached to the
headquarters of the Japanese Gar-
rison in Tientsin.

S.D. Rep

《字林西报》，1937年8月13日，星期五

北田将由原田熊吉接替

武官将被召回日本

日本驻华大使馆武官北田精一少将（Major-Gen. Seiichi Kita）在过去17个月内担任该职，武官室昨日宣布，他将于8月15日乘坐“龙田丸”号（m.v. Tatsuta Maru）轮船离开此处前往日本。

公告补充称，该军官抵达首都后将会获得晋升。

《上海日日新闻》称，近卫师团第四联队联队长原田熊吉少将（Major-Gen. Kumakichi Harada）将接替北田少将，后者将被派往天津日本驻屯军司令部任职。

S.D. Rep

April 22, 1936. Morning Translation.

NICHI-NICHI

ARRIVAL OF MAJOR-GENERAL KITA

Major-General Kita, the newly
appointed Military Attache to China, arrived at Shanghai
on the S. S. Asama Maru at 4 p.m. yesterday.
He informed newspaper reporters
that he would follow the policy of his predecessor.
The General is staying at the Towa Yoko Hotel on Boone
Road.

LANDING PARTY TO GIVE ENTERTAINMENT

Arrangements are being made for
an entertainment to be given by officers and marines
at the Marine headquarters on Kiangwan Road at 10 a.m.
April 26.
The marine headquarters has
issued 300 invitations. Admission tickets for
Japanese residents may be obtained from the Japanese
Residents Corporation.

NIPPO

NEW SITUATION IN THIBET

The Nippo publishes the following
comment:-
Great Britain is planning to place
Thibet under her control.
The India-Thibet railway will
create a new situation there. From the military point
of view the railway will be able to transport the British
frontier guards to the capital of Thibet within 24 hours.
This will place Great Britain in a better position
than the Nanking Government.
There is little hope of the
Panchan Lama entering Thibet. The Nanking Government
has a representative in Thibet but he is only a figurehead.
The pro-British party in Thibet is becoming very influential.
Great Britain is extending her
influence to Sinkiang and Thibet and she is now endeavouring
to open a route to Thibet because Soviet influence in
Sinkiang is far greater than hers.

THE APPOINTMENT OF A JAPANESE AMBASSADOR TO CHINA

Chinese newspapers are taking a
wrong view of the appointment of Consul-General Kawagoe
at Tientsin as Ambassador to China. They allege that Japan
does not seem to regard China seriously as she has
appointed a Consul-General to become an Ambassador to
China. They further state that the Ambassador may adopt
a strong policy. All this shows that China has not
been paying much attention to Japanese affairs because
Mr. Kawagoe has served as Consul-General at Tsingtao,
Canton and Tientsin and should, therefore, be well known
to Chinese officials.

1936年4月22日。晨间译稿。

《日日新闻》

北田少将抵达

新任驻华武官北田少将于昨日下午4时乘坐“浅间丸”号（S. S. Asama Maru）轮抵达上海。
他对报社记者表示，他将遵循其前任的政策。
这位将军现住在布恩路（Boone Road，今惠民路）的东和洋行旅馆（Towa Yoko Hotel）。

登陆部队将举行娱乐活动

正在安排由军官和海军陆战队员于4月26日上午10时在江湾路海军陆战队总部举行的娱乐活动。
海军陆战队总部已发出300份请柬。日本侨民可从日本居留民团获取入场券。

《日本日报》（NIPPO）

西藏的新局势

《日本日报》发表如下评论：
英国正计划将西藏置于其控制之下。
印藏铁路将在当地造成新的局势。从军事角度来看，该铁路能够在24小时内将英国边防警卫运送到西藏首府。这将使英国处于比南京政府更有利的地位。
班禅喇嘛进入西藏的希望渺茫。南京政府在西藏有一名代表，但他只是个傀儡。西藏的亲英派势力正变得非常有影响力。
英国正将其影响力扩展至新疆和西藏，目前正努力开辟一条通往西藏的路线，因为苏联在新疆的影响力远大于英国。

任命日本驻华大使

中国报纸对任命川越茂（Kawagoe）总领事为驻华大使一事持有错误看法。它们声称，日本似乎并未认真对待中国，因为它任命了一位总领事成为驻华大使。它们还称，这位大使可能会采取强硬政策。所有这些都表明，中国并未过多关注日本事务，因为川越先生曾在青岛、广州和天津担任总领事，因此应为中国官员所熟知。
